abstract: A 32-year-old woman was admitted to our hospital complaining of anterior chest pain for 3 months. Chest radiograph revealed a 30-mm mass in the anterior mediastinum. Contrast-enhanced CT scanning revealed a nonhomogeneous cystic mass with a fat or oil component and a thick wall with calcifications. The mass seemed to have invaded the pericardium and great vessels. Thoracotomy demonstrated hairs in the cystic lesions, with hard components that invaded the pericardium and great vessels. Due to extensive vascular invasion, the mass was incompletely resected. Pathologic examination demonstrated the presence of adenocarcinoma, so we diagnosed this case as teratoma with malignant transformation.
abstract_ja: 32歳の女性が3か月前からの前胸部痛を主訴に当院を受診した。胸部X線写真で前縦隔に30mmの腫瘤を認めた。造影CTでは、脂肪成分と石灰化を伴う厚い壁を有する不均一な嚢胞性腫瘤を認め、心膜および大血管への浸潤が疑われた。開胸術で嚢胞内に毛髪を認め、硬い成分が心膜および大血管に浸潤していた。広範な血管浸潤のため腫瘤は不完全切除にとどまった。病理組織学的検査で腺癌の存在が確認され、奇形腫の悪性転化と診断した。
